name: Tim Dooley Atlas — Unified Manifest
purpose: One human-readable map of the entire repository. The project remains layered internally, but every layer is addressable through one canonical atlas manifest.
principle: One atlas, many layers. Records are the objects; relationships explain how they connect; evidence explains what is known; architecture explains where things belong.

architecture.label: Architecture
architecture.purpose: Canonical Frame, Tree and 33-level information architecture.

graph.label: Graph
graph.purpose: Nodes and explicit relationships joining the archive.

world.label: World
world.purpose: 195 canonical nations and their geographic, institutional and social layers.

research.label: Evidence
research.purpose: Facts, sources, events and research material with provenance and confidence.

systems.label: Systems
systems.purpose: Economic, energy, infrastructure, technology, labour, finance and strategic-system studies.

mythology.label: Potatoism
mythology.purpose: Project mythology, symbols, lore and interpretive architecture, kept distinct from empirical evidence.

rule: Never require the user to understand the backend file structure before they can understand the project. The website is the map; the JSON files are the machinery beneath it.
